name.zh: 一年一班说明选拔战规则

periods.summary: Yuri Oreki introduces herself and explains the new real-combat selection system for choosing six Seven Stars representatives.
periods.cause: Kurono abolishes ability-value selection in favor of all-student real-combat selection.
periods.process: Yuri tells students schedules will arrive via student handbook, participation is optional, and each participant should expect about ten matches. She encourages students to try, then overexerts herself and coughs blood.
periods.outcome: Ikki gains the official opportunity he was denied the previous year; classmates learn about the new system.
periods.aftermath: Ikki escorts Yuri to the infirmary, and classmates soon approach him about the online Stella duel video.
casualties: Yuri coughs/vomits blood due to overexcitement
periods.significance: Launches the volume's school-competition framework and gives Ikki a path toward graduation.
